

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Metal Dragon|kanji=庚辰|romaji=kanoe tatsu|onyomi=kōshin|p=gēngchén|w=keng-ch'en|mi=kɤŋ⁵³ ʈ͡ʂʰən|y=geng1 san4|j=geng1 san4|ci=kɪŋ sɐn|mc=kæŋ ɖin|oc-bs=kˤraŋ ɖiŋ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Metal Dragon''' (庚辰, ''kanoe tatsu''; onyomi ''kōshin'') is the 17th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 17th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Snake|ja|辛巳}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''辰'' (Dragon) is Yang Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Dragon (庚辰)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngchén
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 san4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoe-tatsu
*** On'yomi: kōshin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongjin (경진)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Thìn

==Months of Yang Metal Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Metal Dragon==
* {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu}} (the founder and first {{ill|Emperor of Japan|en|Emperor of Japan|qid=Q208233|lt=Emperor}} of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}})'s birthday.

=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 3rd day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hando|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
